text:
All panelists agree that the scheduled end-to-end travel time between Orrinford Junction and Tarnside Park is 23 minutes, and trains will run every 6 minutes at peak.

Answer: 23 minutes end-to-end; every 6 minutes at peak.

All panelists agree that dredging will deepen the berth pocket from 14.5 metres to 17.8 metres, and the terminal's planned annual capacity after expansion will be 2.1 million TEU.

Answer: Dredging will deepen the berth pocket to 17.8 metres, and the terminal's annual capacity after expansion will be 2.1 million TEU.

The three-phase expansion programme lays 12.4 km (Phase 1), 8.7 km (Phase 2), and 15.6 km (Phase 3) of new pipe. The existing 184 km network is not included. The total is 12.4 + 8.7 + 15.6 = 36.7 km.

Answer: 36.7 kilometres

The original public opening was 14 September 2026. An announced 11-week delay (77 days) shifts the date forward to 30 November 2026.

Answer: 30 November 2026

All panelists agree that mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg in the tirnapexil arm at week 16 (E4), and hyperkalaemia was reported in 19 tirnapexil participants (E6).

Answer: Mean systolic blood pressure fell by 13.6 mmHg; 19 tirnapexil participants had hyperkalaemia.

All panelists agree that FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks in the placebo group. The most common adverse event was diarrhoea, reported in 22% of olvemarin participants.

Answer: FVC declined by 171 mL over 52 weeks in the placebo group; the most common adverse event was diarrhoea.

All panelists agree that 54 of 450 participants in the senotrazide arm discontinued the study drug before day 3, yielding 54 ÷ 450 = 12%.

Answer: 12%

All five panelists agree that 312 participants were randomized to pelvastrin, with 27 withdrawing consent, 14 lost to follow-up, and 19 dying before month 24 (60 total non-completers). Since all others completed follow-up, 312 − 60 = 252.

Answer: 252

All panelists unanimously agree on both figures based on the evidence packet. The year-end order backlog was $386 million (E5), and the company guided fiscal-2026 revenue growth of 6% to 8% (E6).

Answer: Corvane Logistics' year-end order backlog was $386 million, with fiscal-2026 revenue growth guidance of 6%–8%.

All panelists unanimously agree on both figures based on the evidence packet. Ostrel Savings Bank's CET1 ratio at year end was 14.3% (E2), and its net interest margin for 2025 was 2.17% (E3).

Answer: CET1 ratio: 14.3%; net interest margin: 2.17%.

Brightfen Foods' net sales increased from $250 million in fiscal 2024 to $295 million in fiscal 2025, a rise of $45 million. Calculated against the fiscal 2024 base, this represents 18% growth.

Answer: 18%

Tamberlin Software defines free cash flow as operating cash flow minus capital expenditures. For fiscal 2025, operating cash flow was $87.3 million and capital expenditures were $52.9 million. Subtracting gives $87.3M − $52.9M = $34.4 million.

Answer: $34.4 million

All five panelists unanimously agree that the jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and declined to award punitive damages, citing evidence E4 and E5.

Answer: The jury awarded $1.64 million in compensatory damages and did not award punitive damages.

All panelists agree on the figures. The contractual cap on Solgrave's total liability was 7.5 million euros, and the tribunal awarded Ventrica 6.9 million euros, which fell below the cap.

Answer: The contractual cap was €7.5 million; the tribunal awarded Ventrica €6.9 million.

All panelists agree that the effective date is 18 February 2025 and that payment is due within 45 calendar days, counting 19 February as day 1. February provides 10 days, March provides 31 days (41 total), and the remaining 4 days fall in April, landing on 4 April 2025.

Answer: 4 April 2025

The defendant was ordered to pay compensatory damages of $2.35 million (already reflecting the 20% contributory-negligence reduction), prejudgment interest of $0.41 million, and taxable costs of $0.12 million. Legal fees of $0.63 million are not recoverable. The sum is $2.35M + $0.41M + $0.12M = $2.88 million.

Answer: $2.88 million

All panelists agree, citing evidence E4, that the tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and was found at a depth of 3.8 metres in the core.

Answer: The tephra layer was dated to 4,270 years before present and found at a depth of 3.8 metres.

All panelists agree that LXP-9 exhibited a room-temperature ionic conductivity of 0.84 mS/cm and that test cells retained 88% of their initial capacity after 500 cycles.

Answer: 0.84 mS/cm ionic conductivity; 88% capacity retention after 500 cycles.

The terminus retreated 384 metres between the 2008 and 2024 surveys, a 16-year interval. Dividing 384 by 16 yields an average retreat rate of 24 metres per year.

Answer: 24 metres per year

The number of breeding pairs fell from 1,480 in 2015 to 1,110 in 2025, a decline of 370 pairs. Measured against the 2015 baseline, this is 370 ÷ 1,480 = 25%.

Answer: 25%

All panelists unanimously agree on both figures. Evidence E3 states that records of 48,600 patients were exposed. Evidence E2 confirms that forensic investigators determined the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025 using a stolen contractor password. The 12 August 2025 date (E1) is the detection date, not the initial access date.

Answer: 48,600 patients' records were exposed, and the attacker first gained access on 29 July 2025.

All panelists unanimously agree that an estimated 340 kilograms of ammonia was released before the line was isolated (E3), and 3 of the 17 workers evaluated at hospital were admitted overnight (E5).

Answer: 340 kilograms of ammonia were released, and 3 workers were admitted to hospital overnight.

The first errors occurred at 22:47 UTC on 9 October (E1), and the company recorded the outage ending at 03:12 UTC on 10 October (E5). The elapsed time is 4 hours and 25 minutes (265 minutes).

Answer: 4 hours and 25 minutes

The incident lasted 35 minutes with 1,200 checkout attempts per minute, yielding 42,000 total attempts. At a 30% failure rate, 12,600 attempts failed.

Answer: 12,600
